setup.intro: Pick a mode, the number of rounds and the music, then jump in.

ranked.title: Ranked
ranked.description: The standard set. Your score counts for the leaderboard.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: Pick your own music. Not ranked.

music.heading: Music
music.rankedNote: Ranked always uses the standard set. To pick genres, artists or decades, switch to Practice.

setup.playlistRequired: Pick a playlist to start the match.

errors.inProgress: You already have a match in progress. Finish that one first.
errors.notEnoughTracks: This music does not have enough songs for {{n}} rounds ({{missing}} short). Remove a filter or pick fewer rounds.
errors.playlistNotFound: This playlist is no longer available. The playlist list has been refreshed, please choose another.
errors.rateLimited: You are going too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknown: Could not create the match. Please try again.

picker.filterHint: Pick several values in one group to widen the pool, and several groups to narrow it. Pick nothing to play the whole catalog.
picker.limit: At most {{n}} choices in one group.
picker.empty: The catalog has nothing to pick yet.

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: Turn it on and every tap plays a note, higher towards the right.

ranked.title: This match counts for the ranking
ranked.body: The standard set, the same music for everyone. A ranked match cannot be abandoned: if you leave, it is kept for 30 minutes so you can come back and finish it.
ranked.guest: You are playing as a guest, so your score is not on the board yet. When you sign in, your ranked scores are merged and appear on the board.

practice.title: This match does not count for the ranking
practice.body: You chose the music, so the score stays off the board. Points, combos, history and badges still count.

ladder.heading: Hear less, score more
ladder.note: Replaying what is open is free. A wrong guess opens the next level.
ladder.combo: Right at 2s or 5s several rounds in a row: the second round earns 10% more, from the third on 20% more of the base score.

ranked.title: Leave the ranked match?
ranked.body: A ranked match cannot be abandoned. It is kept for 30 minutes: come back within that time to continue this very round. After 30 minutes it becomes abandoned and does not count for the ranking.

practice.title: Quit the practice match?
practice.body: Finished rounds are kept. The round in play does not count.

exit.failed: Could not quit the match. Please try again.

errors.action: That did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: You are going too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.loadBody: Check your connection and try again.

missing.title: This match was not found
missing.body: It does not exist or it is not yours.

other.title: You have another match in progress
other.body: Each player has one match in progress at a time. Finish that one before starting a new one.

summary.guestNote: You are playing as a guest: the score reaches the board once you sign in.

share.title: My Meloo result
share.failed: Could not share. Please try again.
